content.short: TON Radar is a TON ecosystem explorer for tracking projects, tokens, prices, and ecosystem analytics.
content.description: TON Radar is an ecosystem explorer for The Open Network. Its site describes project discovery, TON token markets, project listings, prices, and analytics for the TON blockchain ecosystem. The listing fits infrastructure tooling because it helps users discover apps and monitor ecosystem activity rather than executing swaps or custodying assets. TON Radar belongs with DeFi tooling because it helps users or developers understand, move, or connect assets across protocols. TON Radar is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
